description: Characters the studio prepares from config/character-sources.json (scripts/fetch_characters.py). rig_file is relative to .runtime/downloads/; each prepared character lands in .runtime/characters/<id>/ with its licence copied in.

characters.name: SOMA-X neutral body
characters.description: NVIDIA's SOMA neutral body: the skeleton the physics body was derived from, so every body maps one to one. Untextured skin.

characters.name: Quaternius Superhero (male)
characters.description: Stylised textured base character (CC0) on an Unreal-style rig, retargeted onto the physical body.

characters.name: Quaternius Superhero (female)
characters.description: Stylised textured base character (CC0) on an Unreal-style rig, retargeted onto the physical body.

characters.name: KayKit Knight
characters.description: Low-poly adventurer (CC0); its short rig has no shoulders or second spine joint, so those bodies are skipped.

characters.name: Cesium Man
characters.description: The Khronos glTF sample character (CC-BY 4.0, Cesium); a simple 19-joint rig.
